Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information for verification.

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information

It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode, which might be why I’m not getting any service. What should I do next? Should I turn off Airplane Mode?

Yes, please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. This will re-enable all wireless communications, including cellular service and mobile data. After you turn off Airplane Mode, check if your mobile data connection improves. If you want, I can guide you through the steps to turn it off.

1. Verify if your SIM card is active and properly working.
2. Check if your line is suspended or has any restrictions.
3. Confirm that your mobile data settings and APN settings are correct.

Since your SIM card is active and your line is not suspended, the next step is to check your phone's APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can cause mobile data to not work properly even if you have good signal and an active SIM.

Could you please check your APN settings on your phone and let me know if they appear correct or if you see any errors? If you want, I can guide you on how to reset the APN settings to default.

Since your APN settings appear to be correct, the next step is to check if any data-limiting features like Data Saver mode are enabled on your phone, as these can affect mobile data performance.

Could you please check if Data Saver mode is turned on? If it is, try turning it off and then test your mobile data again. If you want, I can guide you on how to check and toggle Data Saver mode.
Data Saver mode is OFF.

Next, let's check if your phone is connected to a VPN, as an active VPN can sometimes cause slow or no internet connection. Could you please check if a VPN is currently connected on your phone? If it is, try disconnecting it and then test your mobile data again. If you want, I can guide you on how to check and disconnect a VPN.
VPN is turned OFF.
I checked, and there is no VPN connected on my phone. What should I do next to fix my mobile data and get excellent internet speed?

Since your phone has excellent signal, active SIM, correct APN settings, Data Saver off, and no VPN connected, but you still have no mobile data connection, the next step is to check your phone's network mode preference.

If your phone is set to a lower network mode like 2G or 3G, it can cause slow or no data connection even if the signal looks good.

Could you please check your phone's network mode preference and let me know what it is set to? If you want, I can guide you on how to check and change it to a preferred mode like 4G/5G.
